Title: Linux support in Azure App Service

Body.Content:
Azure App Service now allows developers to choose Linux, making web applications run on Linux natively. So it's easier to work directly with .htaccess files or avoid using modified extensions or code. This includes streamlined deployment abilities with deployment slots, custom domains, SSL configuration, continuous deployment, and horizontal and vertical scaling.

Read more in our blog post.
